articles.translatedTitle: Tomoyasu Hotei releases two videos simultaneously, “HOTEI 45th CELEBRATION GIGS” and “HOTEI FES” to celebrate his 45th anniversary year.
articles.translatedExcerpt: Tomoyasu Hotei's special live performance at Keio Arena TOKYO Main Arena, which he held in the year of his 45th anniversary as an artist, and the festival ``HOTEI FES'' held at G Messe Gunma will be made into video works and released simultaneously on December 16th. Tomoyasu Hotei will celebrate his 45th anniversary as an artist in 2026. Currently, <HOTEI the LIVE 2026 “45th Celebration GIGS” STAY WILD TOUR> is being held. articles.translatedTitle: Rachel Chinouriri, new AL release
articles.translatedExcerpt: Rachel Chinouriri released her new album ``I think I spoke too soon'' on Friday, October 16, 2026. This 12-song, approximately 40-minute album is an ambitious work that combines the glamor of dance floor synth pop with her signature delicate and frank indie pop. The album depicts the changes in self-perception, the confusion in love, and the difficulty of becoming an adult that people experience in their early to mid-20s. In terms of sound, it combines dynamic synthesizers, danceable beats, and alternative rock textures. While maintaining the intimate indie pop charm established in their debut album, they have expanded their range of expression to a more sophisticated pop sound. articles.excerpt: Sydney Roseが2026年10月16日(金)にニューEP『It Was My First Time』をリリースした。 全5曲で構成される本作は、親しい友人への初めての恋と、その関係がもたらした失望や心の痛みを中心に据えたパーソナルな作品。繊細な歌声と飾らない言葉で、相手の気持ちが分からない不安、自分自身への疑念、そして初めて経験する強烈な感情を描き出している。 恋愛の美しい側面だけでなく、その裏側にある混乱や傷つきやすさまで真正面から向き合った本作。聴く人自身の記憶や感情に静かに寄り添う一作となっている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4317581 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/sydneyrosemusic_/
articles.translatedTitle: Sydney Rose releases new personal EP
articles.translatedExcerpt: Sydney Rose released her new EP “It Was My First Time” on Friday, October 16, 2026. Consisting of five songs, this is a personal piece that centers on his first love for a close friend, and the disappointment and heartache that this relationship brings. With her delicate singing voice and simple words, she portrays the anxiety of not knowing what the other person is feeling, doubts about oneself, and the intense emotions experienced for the first time. This work squarely confronts not only the beautiful side of love, but also the confusion and vulnerability that lies behind it. It is a work that quietly touches the listener's own memories and emotions. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4317581 Artist information https://www.instagram.com/sydneyrosemusic_/

articles.translatedTitle: Angèle releases new AL with 13 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Angèle released her new album “Instinct” on Friday, October 16, 2026. This is an ambitious work that effortlessly transcends the framework of French pop, fusing the dynamism of electronic music with the artist's personal expression that addresses his inner self. Through all 13 songs, the album depicts the importance of moving forward by trusting your own intuition and moving away from the expectations of those around you. The production of this film took place over three years and took place in multiple locations including Brussels, Paris, New York, Rome, and Spain. Angèle writes, composes, and produces the songs himself, building on his previous production style and moving toward more creative freedom. articles.translatedExcerpt: Shonan no Kaze has announced that their new song "Saraba" will be released on October 23, 2026. At the same time, the jacket design was also released. This song was written as the theme song for TV Asahi's Friday night drama premium ``SHADOWS OF THE TEN NINJA'', a historical ninja action drama starring Snow Man Teru Iwamoto. The drama depicts Sasuke (Teru Iwamoto) and other ten heroes who never give up and throw themselves into a life-threatening battle with faith in their hearts in the face of the overwhelmingly powerful Tokugawa army. The highlight is the passionate way of life of people who stick to their will, believe in their friends, and try to carve out a future for themselves, no matter how disadvantageous the situation may be. The new song "Saraba" is an emotional depiction of the ten brave men's readiness and determination, and their battles that touch the hearts of those of us living in the modern world.

articles.translatedTitle: Dead By Inches, 1st AL release decided
articles.translatedExcerpt: Dead By Inches, who develop their own music based on indie rock/dream pop sounds, will release their first album in their career, ``Never Smile Again.'' A catchy and somewhat nostalgic melody line that incorporates the essence of pop music from the 90s and 00s. On the other hand, the lyrics contain extremely introspective words that make one continue to take a hard look at oneself. In addition to songs with Japanese and English lyrics, there are also songs that mix both languages ​​in one song. The contrast between words and melody creates a unique atmosphere reminiscent of Heisei pop music. I don't think I can do anything in this repetition...

articles.translatedTitle: Misaki Umei releases “doodle spring,” which takes her into a new realm with live drums as her starting point.
articles.translatedExcerpt: On Wednesday, October 14, 2026, Misaki Umei released her new single “doodle spring”. This work is a completely new song that has never been performed live. Hayao Ebihara, a drummer who is active in various venues including Haruomi Hosono's band, participated in the production. The drums were recorded for sampling in the studio, and a large number of rhythm patterns and tones were recorded. Umei himself reconstructed the material, making use of the texture of the live drums and creating an organic rhythm and ensemble that was different from his previous work, "L a d y." This is then layered with synth bass and vocals that rise from the ultra-low range, creating a track with a unique groove in which numerous rhythms develop fluidly. In the lyrics, scenes such as ``bright blue'' and ``beautiful night'' are described, along with descriptions of physical pain such as ``glass still stuck in my foot.''

articles.translatedTitle: Ralphie Choo releases melodious new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Ralphie Choo released his new single "Amarillo nena" on Friday, October 9, 2026. Building on the genre-crossing musicality presented in their debut album "SUPERNOVA," this album features a more intimate and melodious sound centered around acoustic guitar, piano, and soft falsetto. This work shows a new creative direction, focusing not only on bold acoustic experiments but also on the beauty and emotional expression of the song itself. The title ``Amarillo'' is a Spanish word that means ``yellow.'' This song is a song that evokes images of the coast and the sun, as well as emotions related to love. articles.translatedExcerpt: After Soul, whose tour for their first album released in March of this year was a great success, has decided to release a new mini-album, ``PLAY WITH MEAN.'' The first song, "Guitar," was performed live during the album tour, and fans were eagerly awaiting its release. This is an anthem for all guitarists by Ryoichi Yamada, who devoted his life to the guitar and was driven crazy. This album, recorded after touring, shows that the band has become stronger physically and has evolved deeper. All of the new songs included have the potential to become representative songs of After Soul in the future. articles.excerpt: Da-iCEがフジテレビ系木曜劇場「波うららかに、めおと日和」主題歌「うららか」を配信リリースした。 本楽曲はDa-iCEの代表曲を手掛ける花村想太と、GENICのメンバー小池竜暉が作詞作曲を担当。 「どんなに時代が変わっても、人を想うシンプルな衝動は100年前から変わらず、そしてその想いが100年後も続いて欲しいという一途な願いも変わらない」というストレートなメッセージを、Da-iCEの圧倒的な歌唱力で聴かせるミドルバラードに仕上がっている。 本日21時にDance Performance Videoをプレミア公開する。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4259062 アーティスト情報 https://da-ice.jp https://www.youtube.…
articles.translatedTitle: Da-iCE starts distribution of drama “Meoto Biyori” sequel theme song “Uraraka”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Da-iCE has released the theme song ``Uraraka'' for Fuji TV's Thursday theater ``Nami Urarakani, Meoto Biyori''. This song was written and composed by Sota Hanamura, who is responsible for Da-iCE's representative songs, and Ryuki Koike, a member of GENIC. The song is a middle ballad that uses Da-iCE's overwhelming singing ability to deliver a straightforward message: ``No matter how times change, the simple impulse to care for others remains the same as it did 100 years ago, and the single-minded desire for that feeling to continue 100 years from now also remains the same.'' The Dance Performance Video will be premiered today at 9pm. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4259062 Artist information https://da-ice.jp https://www.youtube.…

articles.translatedTitle: Nia Smith releases sad new song “Mr Right”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Nia Smith released her new single "Mr Right" on Thursday, October 8, 2026. This song depicts the loneliness and frustration of not being able to meet the ideal partner while all the friends around you are building romantic relationships one after another. Through delicate emotional expressions and a soulful singing voice, it is a song that touches on the longing for love that everyone has felt at least once, and the sadness of waiting for love. Nia Smith is a singer-songwriter from London. It expresses universal emotions in life-sized words. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4271941 Artist information https://www.instagram.com/niasmithy/

In the article, Andreas Wiseman, editor-in-chief of Media's film and international department, reported on the unusual selection of mysterious new artist JYuno and his activities in Japan, and one of the executive producers also said, ``He represents a new generation of Japanese artists whose creativity can transcend national borders.'' articles.translatedTitle: eyed releases teaser video for prologue single "silence". Lyrics written by Fuki Kitamura, music composed by machìna
articles.translatedExcerpt: The teaser video for eyed's prologue single "silence" has been released. In the teaser video, which appears to be an excerpt from the music video, the five members are connected to each other with their long black hair flowing in a desolate landscape with nothing to obstruct their view. It was also revealed that the familiar BGM that was placed over the video, which had a quiet blank space, was the same sound as the video that was released on eyed's SNS on Tuesday, September 1st. Furthermore, it was announced on eyed's SNS that Machìna will produce the track for this song, and Fuki Kitamura will write the lyrics and top line. Machìna, who produced this track, has received worldwide acclaim for his tours with techno master Richie Hawtin and his performance at Berlin's legendary club Berghain, and has been online all over the world.

To coincide with this memorable day, a large-scale collaboration project with JR East (Chuo Line), which is also included in the title of the new song, "JR East x MATSURI 'Koi no Chuo Line' Campaign" has started today. To commemorate the release, four of the six MATSURI members, Matsuoka, Watanabe, Hashizume, and Suzuki, paid a courtesy visit to JR East's Hachioji business headquarters. Afterwards, they moved to JR Hachioji Station and distributed original extra-issue flyers directly to people passing through the station on the memorable release day, in order to "sunrise from Hachioji", which is likened to the lyrics of the new song "Koi no Chuo Line" without prior notice. articles.translatedTitle: lecca releases 20th anniversary album "Lovers & Dreamers". "One Chance feat. RYO the SKYWALKER" MV released
articles.translatedExcerpt: lecca's anniversary album "Lovers & Dreamers", which celebrates the 20th anniversary of her major debut, will be released today, October 14th. The music video for one of the songs on the album, "One Chance feat. RYO the SKYWALKER," has also been released. ``One Chance feat. RYO the SKYWALKER'' is a song that lecca has been admiring for 26 years and has realized her long-held desire for RYO the SKYWALKER, which became the origin of her own musical style. We live in a world filled with information that makes us feel like we can predict the future, but behind the scenes we all feel uncertain about the future and find it difficult to live. This song is a direct encouragement to all those who are feeling stuck, saying, ``There's always an opportunity'' and ``Moving forward.''

articles.translatedTitle: Mummy plastic. , new SG release with 3 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Mummy plastic. released a new single "Paku Pakuchi" containing three songs on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. Unlike the previous work ``Lovemi'', this song has an attractive sound collage that combines typing and live music. This album is also a pop song that is addictive and addictive, with a unique looseness in the lyrics and a hook in the melody, as well as a sound that won't leave your ears. The song is sung with the bitterness of coriander and the bitterness of love, depicting the feelings of the main character, a girl who knows that her love will end, but cannot get rid of it because she is addicted to it, and things always go wrong. It is an ennui and coriander love song. This album also features key ranju as the main vocalist. The coupling includes conversations between the members in the studio and samplings from related bands, all played by Ronrenon.

articles.translatedTitle: Manami releases new EP “AIM STAR” & releases MV for title song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Aimi will release her new EP “AIM STAR” on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. Additionally, the music video for the song "AIM STAR" was released. ``AIM STAR'' has the meaning of ``aiming for'' the shining star, and on the jacket, Manami holding an item with a gun motif is a visual that symbolizes the worldview of the work.
